definitions.gloss: omnivory; omnivorous; eating both plants and animals
definitions.explanation: The dietary characteristic of eating both plant and animal matter. Used for animals, and sometimes metaphorically for people who consume a wide variety of media, genres, or interests.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人間|にんげん}→人間：03523_ningen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{雑食|ざっしょく}⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧だ。
クマ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{雑食|ざっしょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{果物|くだもの}→果物：00509_kudamono⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: Bears are omnivorous and eat both fish and fruit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦に{関|かん}して→に関して：06944_nikanshite⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{雑食|ざっしょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦ジャンル→ジャンル：11017_janru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{問|と}わ→問う：02299_tou⟧ず⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{聴|き}く→聴く：30010_kiku⟧。
examples.english: When it comes to music, he's omnivorous — he listens to anything regardless of genre.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{雑|ざつ}→雑：14582_zatsu⟧ (miscellaneous, mixed) + {食|しょく} (eating, food). Used literally in biology and figuratively to describe someone with wide-ranging, undiscriminating tastes in media, food, or interests.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雑食|ざっしょく}⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧: omnivore
- {雑食|ざっしょく}⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧: omnivorous nature
- {雑食|ざっしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生|い}き{物|もの}→生き物：01783_ikimono⟧: an omnivorous creature

USAGE:
Commonly used figuratively, especially in fan communities and media discussion: {雑食|ざっしょく}⟦リーダー→リーダー：24312_riidaa⟧ (someone who reads any genre), {雑食|ざっしょく}⟦ゲーマー→ゲーマー：06259_geemaa⟧ (someone who plays all types of games). In otaku culture, describes fans who enjoy many different pairings or genres without strong preferences.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{草食|そうしょく}→草食：20954_soushoku⟧: herbivorous — eating only plants; also used figuratively for passive personality
- ⟦{肉食|にくしょく}→肉食：13922_nikushoku⟧: carnivorous — eating only meat; also used figuratively for aggressive personality
- ⟦{偏食|へんしょく}→偏食：07729_henshoku⟧: picky eating — being selective about food
